name: openubmc-developer
description: Automatically analyze and change existing openUBMC source when source ownership, repository extension patterns, authored/generated chains, component lifecycle, persistence, or cross-layer behavior remain unresolved; exclude specified edits, documentation-only work, and separately owned workflows.
author: OpenUBMC Team

prompts: 分析一个现有组件的源码需求，找到当前负责该行为的模块并给出建议
按照现有仓库结构实现组件功能修改并完成聚焦验证
评审一个跨组件源码方案，比较已有实现和正确扩展点
修改控制运行行为的 authored 模型或配置，并验证生成链和直接消费者
完成源码修改后，将已验证的源码事实交给 Build，并由 Build 产出 Upgrade 所需制品
